text: Pinterest 收藏是面向 DSH Web 的双栏面板插件：左侧管理本机收藏夹，右侧浏览 Pinterest。它通过侧边栏入口打开面板，并由 Host 提供搜索、内容读取和收藏持久化。用户可浏览推荐流、搜索图钉、查看详情、保存图片并按收藏夹整理。适合在 DSH 中收集视觉灵感；个性化推荐需要 Pinterest 登录，收藏数据保存在本机。

Pinterest Collection adds a two-pane DSH panel for browsing Pinterest and managing local saves. Search pins, view details, browse feeds, and save images into boards. Sign in for personalized recommendations; collections are stored locally.

pinterest-collect README · Install the plugin：The repository root is the installable bundle entry (`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` and exports into `packages/plugin`), so you can install straight from GitHub:

```text
plugin_manager {
  action: "install_bundle",
  target: "github:extrastu/pinterest-collect"
}

For local development the absolute repository path works the same way (do not point at `packages/plugin` — that is the source package and declares no bundle):

pinterest-collect README · Install the plugin：```text
plugin_manager {
  action: "install_bundle",
  target: "/absolute/path/to/pinterest-collect"
}

Restart Harness once and refresh the page; a “Pinterest Collection” icon appears in the sidebar.
